column3: Port of BootUI 2.4.0 #1597 StaticSecurityAnalysisRule: detects local static security analyzer declarations without running them; bounds 1 MiB/file, <= 64 workflows, symlink/special-file refusal, INDETERMINATE on malformed/oversized. Python adaptation: project root from app package pyproject locator (never cwd); recommendation and url adapted to Python analyzers (Bandit, Semgrep, CodeQL, a sonar-project.properties file, Ruff with S selected).

Rule description adapted: Maven parent and Gradle applied script limitations replaced by Python boundaries (ruff.toml extend not followed, requirements -r includes not followed, remote or organization-managed configuration not resolved).
Refuse site-packages and dist-packages when locating pyproject.toml; applies to both security static analyzer inspection and architecture read_contracts.

sonar-project.properties presence-only inspection decodes leniently (errors=replace, BOM stripped), matching Java new String(bytes, UTF-8) replacement behavior; content-parsed files decode utf-8-sig strictly.
